propositions: The code_health lens must be validated end-to-end against both a Python client fixture and a non-Python (Go or TS) client fixture.
When analyzers (scc/jscpd/npx/lizard via the [metrics] extra) are present, code_health must compute real values for both languages.
When the metrics extra and external tools are absent, code_health must report an honest Unavailable for both languages without crashing or fabricating data.
Present-tool assertions are gated as skip-if-absent integration tests so CI without tools still passes.
agent_process and git-delta churn metrics must compute for both fixtures, reporting committed insertions with zero deletions and one claimed ticket attempt.
Fixtures must use disposable runtime copies with a minimal rebar ticket-store shape rather than untrackable nested git directories.
